text: This report recommends that, subject to obtaining the necessary City approvals, The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place (the "Board") enter into a ten (10) year and eleven (11) month license agreement (the "Licence") with the City of Toronto, as Licensor, and Maple Leaf Sports & Entertainment Partnership (the "Licensee") for certain premises (the "Team Space") in the West Annex of the Enercare Centre, commencing August 1, 2024, and ending on June 30, 2035. The License will be coterminous with the sublease between BPC Coliseum Inc. and the Tenant dated June 16, 2005, as amended and extended by a Sublease Extension and Amending Agreement dated July 1, 2025, and consented to by the City and the Board, as head landlord (collectively, the "Sublease").
